description: Implementation of RecordingHttp2Visitor class methods for HTTP/2 event handling and logging.

classes.name: RecordingHttp2Visitor
classes.description: A class that implements HTTP/2 visitor interface for recording events.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Logs the event when data is ready to be sent, returning the size of the serialized data.

methods.name: OnConnectionError
methods.description: Logs a connection error event with error details.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Logs the frame header details.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Logs the start of settings exchange.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Logs individual setting received.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of settings exchange.

methods.name: OnSettingsAck
methods.description: Logs acknowledgment of settings.

methods.name: OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Logs the start of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Logs a header for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Logs the end of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataPaddingLength
methods.description: Logs data padding length for a stream.

methods.name: OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Logs the start of data for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataForStream
methods.description: Logs data received for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndStream
methods.description: Logs the end of a stream.

methods.name: OnRstStream
methods.description: Logs a reset stream event.

methods.name: OnCloseStream
methods.description: Logs stream closure.

methods.name: OnPriorityForStream
methods.description: Logs priority change for a stream.

methods.name: OnPing
methods.description: Logs a ping event.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseForStream
methods.description: Logs push promise event for a stream.

methods.name: OnGoAway
methods.description: Logs a GOAWAY event.

methods.name: OnWindowUpdate
methods.description: Logs window update event.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Logs before a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Logs after a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnInvalidFrame
methods.description: Logs invalid frame detection.

methods.name: OnBeginMetadataForStream
methods.description: Logs start of metadata for a stream.

methods.name: OnMetadataForStream
methods.description: Logs metadata received for a stream.

methods.name: OnMetadataEndForStream
methods.description: Logs end of metadata for a stream.

methods.name: OnErrorDebug
methods.description: Logs debug error messages.
